forum.page_description: Send us a message and we will get back to you as soon as possible.
forum.success_message: Your message has been sent successfully. Thank you!
forum.turnstile_error: The security verification could not be loaded. Please refresh the page and try again.
forum.turnstile_expired: The security verification expired. Please verify again.

access.disabled: The contact form is currently disabled.
access.guests_not_allowed: Please log in to use the contact form.
access.registered_not_allowed: The contact form is available to guests only.
access.registered_submissions_disabled: Registered user submissions are currently disabled.
access.email_verification_required: Please verify your email address before using the contact form.
access.unavailable: The contact form is currently unavailable.

validation.name_too_short: Your name must be at least 2 characters long.
validation.name_too_long: Your name may not be longer than 100 characters.
validation.email_invalid: Please enter a valid email address.
validation.subject_too_long: The subject may not be longer than {max} characters.
validation.message_too_short: Your message must be at least {min} characters long.
validation.message_too_long: Your message may not be longer than {max} characters.
validation.phone_invalid: Please enter a valid phone number.
validation.privacy_required: You must accept the privacy policy to continue.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.rate_limited: You are sending requests too quickly. Please wait {seconds} seconds and try again.
errors.duplicate: This message has already been sent. Please wait a few minutes before trying again.
errors.turnstile_failed: The security verification failed. Please refresh the page and try again.
errors.turnstile_expired: The security verification expired. Please try again.
errors.turnstile_duplicate: This security verification has already been used. Please refresh the page and try again.
errors.turnstile_unavailable: The security verification service is unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.mail_unavailable: The contact form is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.mail_delivery_failed: Your message could not be sent. Please try again later.
errors.payload_too_large: The submitted data is too large.
errors.bad_request: Invalid request. Please refresh the page and try again.

settings.enabled_help: When disabled, the contact page and its navigation item are unavailable. Settings are kept.
settings.show_in_navigation_help: Adds a contact link to the forum's left sidebar.
settings.nav_label_help: Leave empty to use the translated default (Contact / İletişim).
settings.page_title_help: Leave empty to use the translated default.
settings.page_description_help: Shown below the page title. Plain text only.
settings.success_message_help: Shown after a message is sent successfully. Leave empty for the translated default.
settings.categories_help: One category per line. The category field is hidden when this list is empty.
settings.default_language_help: Used as a fallback when the current forum language is not English or Turkish. The current language always wins when available.
settings.access_mode_label: Who can use the contact form?
settings.access_mode_help: This is enforced on the server. The additional switches below can narrow access further.
settings.allow_guest_submissions_help: Guests must still complete all enabled security checks.
settings.allow_registered_submissions_help: When off, logged-in users cannot submit the form.
settings.require_email_verification_label: Require verified email for registered users
settings.require_email_verification_help: Registered users with an unverified email address are denied. Guests are unaffected.
settings.prefill_authenticated_label: Prefill name and email for logged-in users
settings.prefill_authenticated_help: Prefills the name and email fields from the current account. Users can still edit them.
settings.privacy_url_help: Optional link to your privacy policy. Only http and https URLs are accepted.
settings.field_enabled_help: Show this field on the contact form.
settings.field_required_help: The form cannot be submitted without this field.
settings.field_label_help: Leave empty to use the translated default.
settings.field_placeholder_help: Leave empty to use the translated default.
settings.message_min_help: Minimum number of characters for the message.
settings.message_max_help: Maximum number of characters for the message.
settings.subject_max_help: Maximum number of characters for the subject.
settings.recipient_email_help: Where contact notifications are sent. Required when the contact page is enabled.
settings.email_subject_prefix_help: Added in front of the visitor's subject.
settings.sender_name_help: Friendly name used for the sender in the notification. The address comes from Flarum's mail configuration.
settings.reply_to_enabled_help: Only applied when a valid email address was supplied. Reply-To is never set from unvalidated input.
settings.turnstile_enabled_help: Recommended for public guest forms. The secret key is verified on the server.
settings.turnstile_site_key_help: Public key from the Cloudflare Turnstile dashboard.
settings.turnstile_secret_key_help: Private key. It is never sent to the forum frontend or written to logs.
settings.turnstile_theme_help: Theme of the Turnstile widget. Auto follows the visitor's colour scheme.
settings.turnstile_appearance_help: Always shows the widget; interaction-only shows it only when a challenge is required.
settings.turnstile_timeout_help: How long to wait for Cloudflare's Siteverify API. Failed verification blocks the email.
settings.turnstile_expected_hostname_help: Optional. Defaults to the current request host. Set this if your forum is served through a proxy with a different internal host.
settings.rate_limit_enabled_help: Limits submissions per hashed IP address. Raw IP addresses are never stored.
settings.rate_limit_max_help: Number of messages allowed per IP address in the time window.
settings.rate_limit_window_help: The time window for the maximum submissions setting.
settings.cooldown_seconds_help: Minimum time between two submissions from the same IP address. Set to 0 to disable.
settings.honeypot_enabled_help: Adds a hidden field that humans do not fill in. Detected bots receive a fake success response.
settings.time_trap_enabled_help: Rejects forms submitted faster than humans normally can. Uses a hidden elapsed-time value.
settings.time_trap_seconds_help: Forms submitted faster than this are treated as bots.
settings.duplicate_window_seconds_help: Identical submissions from the same IP are rejected during this period. Set to 0 to disable.
settings.max_request_bytes_help: Requests larger than this are rejected before validation. Default is 65536 bytes (64 KB).

validation.too_long: {field} may not be longer than {max} characters.
validation.whitespace: {field} may not contain spaces or line breaks.
validation.email: {field} must be a valid email address.
validation.url: {field} must be a valid http or https URL.
validation.hostname: {field} must be a valid hostname, optionally with a port.
validation.message_range: The minimum message length cannot be greater than the maximum message length.
validation.categories_empty: Add at least one category before enabling the category field.
validation.category_too_long: Each category may not be longer than 100 characters.
validation.turnstile_keys: Both the Turnstile site key and secret key are required when Turnstile is enabled.
validation.no_content_field: Enable at least the email field or the message field when the contact page is enabled.

permissions.bypass_rate_limit_help: Members of groups with this permission are not subject to the contact form cooldown or per-IP limits.

email.heading: New contact message
email.intro: A new message was submitted through the contact form.
